A higher roadside-to-general ratio indicates stronger local traffic source contribution. Which pollutant shows a larger roadside enhancement, indicating it is more dominated by local traffic sources? Return both ratios rounded to 2 decimal places and the more traffic-dominated pollutant name.
turns.actual_response:
For October 2025:

- NO2 roadside-to-general ratio: 2.26
- PM2.5 roadside-to-general ratio: 1.42
- More traffic-dominated pollutant: NO2

Roadside NO2 was 2.26 times the general-station average, while roadside PM2.5 was 1.42 times the general-station average. Therefore, NO2 showed the larger roadside enhancement, indicating stronger dominance by local traffic sources.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

start, end = "2025-10-01 00:00:00", "2025-11-01 00:00:00"

# Count applicable hourly readings first, then compute aggregated pollutant means and ratios.
count_q = text("""
SELECT s.station_type::text AS station_type,
       COUNT(*) AS total_hours,
       COUNT(h.no2) AS no2_hours,
       COUNT(h.pm2_5) AS pm25_hours,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.station_type='ROADSIDE' AND ((EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) >= 7 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) < 10) OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) >= 17 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) < 20))) AS roadside_rush_hours,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.station_type='ROADSIDE' AND NOT ((EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) >= 7 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) < 10) OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) >= 17 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) < 20))) AS roadside_offpeak_hours
FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
JOIN air_quality_station s ON h.station_id = s.id
WHERE h.datetime >= :start AND h.datetime < :end
GROUP BY s.station_type
ORDER BY s.station_type
""")
counts = pd.read_sql(count_q, engine, params={"start": start, "end": end})

agg_q = text("""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.station_type::text AS station_type, h.no2, h.pm2_5, h.datetime
  FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
  JOIN air_quality_station s ON h.station_id = s.id
  WHERE h.datetime >= :start AND h.datetime < :end
),
type_avg AS (
  SELECT station_type, AVG(no2) AS avg_no2, AVG(pm2_5) AS avg_pm25
  FROM base
  GROUP BY station_type
),
roadside_period AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN ((EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) >= 7 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) < 10)
                OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) >= 17 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) < 20))
              THEN 'rush' ELSE 'offpeak' END AS period,
         AVG(no2) AS avg_no2, AVG(pm2_5) AS avg_pm25
  FROM base
  WHERE station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_no2 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='ROADSIDE') / NULLIF((SELECT avg_no2 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='GENERAL'), 0) AS no2_roadside_general_ratio,
  (SELECT avg_pm25 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='ROADSIDE') / NULLIF((SELECT avg_pm25 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='GENERAL'), 0) AS pm25_roadside_general_ratio,
  (SELECT avg_no2 / NULLIF(avg_pm25, 0) FROM roadside_period WHERE period='rush') AS rush_no2_pm25_ratio,
  (SELECT avg_no2 / NULLIF(avg_pm25, 0) FROM roadside_period WHERE period='offpeak') AS offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio,
  (SELECT avg_no2 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='ROADSIDE') AS roadside_avg_no2,
  (SELECT avg_no2 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='GENERAL') AS general_avg_no2,
  (SELECT avg_pm25 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='ROADSIDE') AS roadside_avg_pm25,
  (SELECT avg_pm25 FROM type_avg WHERE station_type='GENERAL') AS general_avg_pm25
""")
res = pd.read_sql(agg_q, engine, params={"start": start, "end": end}).iloc[0]

no2_roadside_general_ratio = round(float(res["no2_roadside_general_ratio"]), 2)
pm25_roadside_general_ratio = round(float(res["pm25_roadside_general_ratio"]), 2)
more_traffic_dominated = "NO2" if no2_roadside_general_ratio > pm25_roadside_general_ratio else ("PM2.5" if pm25_roadside_general_ratio > no2_roadside_general_ratio else "Tie")
rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(float(res["rush_no2_pm25_ratio"]), 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(float(res["offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio"]), 2)

print("October 2025 hourly reading counts by station class:")
print(counts.to_string(index=False))
print("\nAggregated means and computed ratios:")
print(pd.DataFrame([{
    "roadside_avg_no2": round(float(res["roadside_avg_no2"]), 2),
    "general_avg_no2": round(float(res["general_avg_no2"]), 2),
    "roadside_avg_pm25": round(float(res["roadside_avg_pm25"]), 2),
    "general_avg_pm25": round(float(res["general_avg_pm25"]), 2),
    "no2_roadside_general_ratio": no2_roadside_general_ratio,
    "pm25_roadside_general_ratio": pm25_roadside_general_ratio,
    "more_traffic_dominated": more_traffic_dominated,
    "rush_no2_pm25_ratio": rush_no2_pm25_ratio,
    "offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio": offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio
}]).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

start, end = "2025-10-01 00:00:00", "2025-11-01 00:00:00"

# Check eligible roadside readings for the specified rush/off-peak definitions, then aggregate.
q = text("""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT h.no2, h.pm2_5,
         CASE
           WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) IN (8,17,18) THEN 'rush'
           WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) IN (0,1,2,3,4,10,11,12,13,14) THEN 'offpeak'
         END AS period
  FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
  JOIN air_quality_station s ON h.station_id = s.id
  WHERE s.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
    AND h.datetime >= :start AND h.datetime < :end
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.datetime) IN (0,1,2,3,4,8,10,11,12,13,14,17,18)
)
SELECT period,
       COUNT(*) AS total_hours,
       COUNT(no2) AS no2_hours,
       COUNT(pm2_5) AS pm25_hours,
       AVG(no2) AS avg_no2,
       AVG(pm2_5) AS avg_pm25,
       AVG(no2) / NULLIF(AVG(pm2_5), 0) AS no2_pm25_ratio
FROM base
WHERE period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
""")
period_stats = pd.read_sql(q, engine, params={"start": start, "end": end})

rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(float(period_stats.loc[period_stats["period"]=="rush", "no2_pm25_ratio"].iloc[0]), 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(float(period_stats.loc[period_stats["period"]=="offpeak", "no2_pm25_ratio"].iloc[0]), 2)

print("October 2025 roadside station NO2-to-PM2.5 ratios for specified periods:")
print(period_stats.assign(
    avg_no2=period_stats["avg_no2"].round(2),
    avg_pm25=period_stats["avg_pm25"].round(2),
    no2_pm25_ratio=period_stats["no2_pm25_ratio"].round(2)
).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nrush_no2_pm25_ratio = {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")
